content: If it is close to the time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose entirely. Proceed to take your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Storage Instructions: Store this medication at room temperature. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product has expired or is no longer needed, ensure it is discarded properly according to local regulations or pharmacy guidelines. Important Information About This Product: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific use. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health needs. Additional Notes on Usage: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same therapeutic class. To view formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive detailed instructions on how to access the offer.
